{{Quote|General, do you copy? This is Captain Ferrel of the Attack Cruiser ''Arbitrator''. My ship and the ''Guardian'' are here to assist.|Ferrel, to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]|<ref name="TCWA" />}}
'''Ferrel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Arbitrator (Venator-class)|''Arbitrator'']].<ref name="TCWA" />
